From Creation (1 AM · 3925 BC) to the end of the seventh millennium · Bible · Dead Sea Scrolls & Essenes · Church · World · 662 prophecies
Each millennium is one "day" of equal width; inside a day, busier centuries get more room. Dates follow Scripture and Ken Johnson's chronology (AM = AD + 3925). "c." = approximate.
